attributes.long_name: Fraction of observed, burnable 300 m pixels burned at least once in 2024
attributes.comment: Denominator: observed, burnable pixels. Fire_cci JD codes: day of year = burned; 0 = not burned; -1 = not observed (excluded); -2 = not burnable (excluded). These code meanings are in the Fire_cci Product User Guide, not in the source GeoTIFF.
attributes.source: ESA Fire_cci SYN burned area pixel v1.1 (Sentinel-3) doi:10.5285/d441079fc77f49fabeb41330612b252f
